long_biography.plain_text:
Power Station Ltd placed Paul Kinkley's diesel-mechanical experience at the centre of its service model. Based in Mississauga, the company supplied standby systems, repaired machinery and maintained generators for public and commercial facilities. Kinkley remained close enough to field operations that technical reliability, not simply equipment sales, defined the business.

After Hurricane Dorian devastated the Abaco Islands, Kinkley applied those field-service skills to emergency recovery. He travelled with colleagues to repair essential generators for local recovery and future work camps, extending the firm's capabilities beyond its Canadian contracts. The work placed specialist generator maintenance inside the wider effort to restore basic services after the storm.
